## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Required checklist

Check an item only with evidence below. Leave unmet items unchecked and state the blocker. Mark an inapplicable item N/A with a reason; N/A does not waive an applicable requirement.

- [ ] Every explicit user requirement and requested increment is accounted for.
- [ ] Applicable repository guidance was followed and the final diff was reviewed.
- [ ] Requested delegation and senior validation have concrete evidence, or an explicit N/A reason.
- [ ] Behavior bugs have a regression test observed failing before the fix and passing afterward; documentation-only changes may state N/A.
- [ ] Required verification commands were run and their results are recorded.
- [ ] Remaining failures, blockers, and unverified requirements are disclosed; the completion claim matches the evidence.

## Evidence

List requirement-to-change references, delegation/review evidence, and exact verification commands with outcomes. For UI changes, include the viewport/theme/language states checked.

## Outstanding work

List any unchecked applicable requirement, failure, or limitation. State "None" only after verification.
